'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Dan Tartaglione DS Tatooine: Jabba's Palace''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dan Tartaglione]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Jabba's Palace|JP-D-tatooinejabbaspalace.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Shoot 'Em In Their Face
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
